name: Cast Steel Shot
summary: Spherical cast steel abrasive for shot blasting, foundry sand removal and shot peening.
description: Cast steel shot is made from steel scrap through melting, centrifugal atomization or water-jet impact forming, secondary purification, quenching, tempering and mechanical screening. It offers moderate hardness, impact resistance and stable cleaning brightness for metal workpieces.

name: Cast Steel Grit
summary: Angular high-carbon steel grit for descaling, rust removal and aggressive surface profiling.
description: Cast steel grit is an upgraded substitute for cast iron sand and iron sand. It is produced from high-carbon or alloy steel and provides angular cutting action, high impact resistance and consistent surface roughness.

name: Cut Wire Shot
summary: Precisely cut wire abrasive for long service life and controlled peening intensity.
description: Cut wire shot is made from cold-drawn steel wire and can be supplied in cylindrical or conditioned rounded forms. Its dense structure and uniform grain size make it suitable for repeated use in blasting and peening equipment.

specs.Materials: High carbon steel, low carbon steel, stainless steel
specs.Service life: Long cyclic life under suitable equipment settings

name: Conditioned Cut Wire Shot
summary: Rounded high-manganese cut wire media for bright, uniform surface finishing.
description: Conditioned cut wire shot is produced by wire drawing, cutting and rounding. It has a bright cylindrical or rounded appearance, balanced hardness and controlled consumption during use.

name: Stainless Steel Shot
summary: Low-dust stainless shot for non-ferrous and stainless workpiece surface treatment.
description: Stainless steel shot is made by stainless wire cutting and rounding or atomized melting. It provides long life, low dust and clean finishing on non-ferrous metals and stainless workpieces.

name: Lost Foam Casting Sand
summary: Dry filling sand for lost foam casting molds and vapor pattern support.
description: Lost foam casting sand fills and surrounds foam patterns, supporting the mold cavity and helping gases escape when molten metal vaporizes the pattern.

specs.Use: Dry sand filling around foam patterns
specs.Function: Prevent cavity collapse and support vapor escape

name: Aluminum Shot
summary: Soft non-ferrous shot for polishing copper, aluminum and delicate metal parts.
description: Aluminum shot is manufactured from aluminum alloy with uniform particle size and moderate hardness. It cleans and polishes non-ferrous workpieces without aggressive base material damage.

name: Copper Shot
summary: Golden copper media for strengthening, matte finishing and color enhancement.
description: Copper shot is refined through drawing, cutting and rounding. It is used where a warm metallic surface effect and gentle strengthening are required.

name: Zinc Shot
summary: Soft zinc abrasive for deburring die cast aluminum and zinc alloy parts.
description: Zinc shot removes burrs while protecting surface quality. It can also create a brightening and protective effect on suitable metal surfaces.

specs.Feature: Low hardness with high bulk density

name: Brown Fused Alumina
summary: Durable alumina abrasive for grinding, blasting and refractory aggregate use.
description: Brown fused alumina is a widely used artificial abrasive with high hardness, good toughness and efficient cost performance.

name: White Fused Alumina
summary: High-purity alumina abrasive for precision grinding and clean cutting.
description: White fused alumina is made from industrial alumina with high purity. It is sharper and more brittle than brown fused alumina, reducing loading and heat during grinding.

name: Glass Beads
summary: Spherical glass media for cleaning, peening and reflective material applications.
description: Glass beads have a smooth spherical surface, chemical stability and reflective properties. They are used for cleaning, strengthening and industrial filling applications.

name: Silicon Carbide
summary: Extremely hard abrasive for cutting, grinding and high-temperature materials.
description: Silicon carbide is synthesized at high temperature from quartz sand and petroleum coke. It offers high hardness, thermal conductivity and heat resistance.

name: Quartz Sand
summary: Hard silica sand for casting cores, filtration, glass and construction materials.
description: Quartz sand is produced from natural quartz stone. Its chemical stability, hardness and temperature resistance make it a basic industrial material.

specs.Feature: Hard, wear resistant and chemically stable

name: Steel Ball
summary: Wear-resistant grinding media for mills in mining, cement and metallurgy.
description: Steel balls provide repeated impact and rolling friction in ball mills, crushing and grinding bulk materials to target particle sizes.

specs.Feature: High hardness, wear resistance and compressive strength

name: Magnetic Steel Pins
summary: Fine magnetic pins for polishing, deburring and hard-to-reach finishing.
description: Magnetic steel pins combine fine probe-like geometry with magnetic movement, supporting efficient polishing and cleaning of small or complex parts.

name: Butterfly Steel Ball
summary: Special steel ball assembly for manual adjustment and low-friction positioning.
description: Butterfly steel ball is a non-standard fastener integrating a steel ball with a butterfly nut for frequent manual linear adjustment applications.

name: Emery
summary: Hard mineral abrasive for grinding, blasting and wear-resistant surfaces.
description: Emery is supplied for durable surface treatment and grinding applications where high hardness and abrasive action are required.

name: Shot Collection Cart
summary: Equipment for collecting and recycling steel shot in blasting workshops.
description: Shot collection carts help recover used steel shot from workshop floors through magnetic or vacuum collection systems, improving recycling efficiency and reducing manual cleaning.

name: Shot Blasting Machine & Parts
summary: Shot blasting machine, impeller, blade, motor and sandblasting accessories.
description: Qishun supplies abrasive media together with related shot blasting machine parts and sandblasting accessories for integrated surface treatment requirements.

specs.Available items: Motor, impeller, blade, sandblasting machine, blasting tank accessories

name: Atomized Stainless Steel Shot
summary: Atomized stainless media for clean finishing and low-contamination blasting.
description: Atomized stainless steel shot is suitable for clean blasting needs where stainless composition, lower contamination and controlled spherical particles are required.
